hypothesis: Halving Xe2 D256 query ownership from256 to128 rows and from32 to16 subgroups improves weighted prefill cost on B70
intervention: Only chunk_policy_head256 QK/PV128x32x32, output128x256, subgroup16x1x1; key tile32, arithmetic, precision, GRF setting, scheduler, prefetch strategy, decode and b16 policies unchanged
capture: Unchanged diagnostic model calls under auto and compact KVarN; capture actual dtype, shape, stride, page mapping, Q/K/V and output for selected extents; inventory every prefill attention call for both exact retained prompts

numerical_gates.reference: FP32 attention on exact captured operands with bottom-right causal mask; grouped heads and query blocks bound temporary memory
numerical_gates.repeatability: Exact same-input output after changed operands, allocator pressure and dirty output/scratch conditioning
numerical_gates.ownership: Finite complete output after NaN prefill, intact surrounding canaries, unchanged inputs

measurement: Serial GPU commands in two persistent workers with separately mapped immutable DSOs; balanced reversed ABBA blocks, at least1s warmup and three100ms windows within1%, capped10s;30 blocks and two fresh starts; raw samples, block bootstrap and drift reporting
cache_conditions: 512MiB streaming read/write conditioner immediately before each measured call, excluded from elapsed time
weighting: Use full observed prefill call extents for16383/65023 tokens. Any interpolation or generated-prefix replay must be identified as a prediction; never weight only the final chunk.
selection: Require correctness plus weighted whole-call improvement greater than max(3%, twice control relative variation), consistently across starts and cache conditions, before service qualification
later_gates: Paired profiler-off model trials at16K/65K within auto and KVarN, unchanged scheduler2048 and512 outputs; model/replay/state gates then MTP2/images before recommendation
stop: Stop on illegal tuple, numerical/determinism/ownership failure, weighted regression or absent service gain. At most one nearest legal reduced-Q tuple if128/16 is illegal. No broad sweep or tolerance relaxation.
